description: T-5358: one delete_row of rows 2-8 (count 7), more rows than the table holds, from the row above it to the row below it: does Excel delete the table, or refuse? Excel refuses a delete of the header row alone (409 InsertDeleteConflict, references.md 'Structured references under row deletes'), and the engine refuses every delete that takes a header row: if Excel refuses this one too, the answer wanted is the refusal and its error code. Sales on S!B3:C7 (header B3:C3 Region/Qty, data rows 4-7 Qty 1,2,4,8), S!C10 99 below it. Sheet F holds A1 =ROWS(Sales[#All]), A2 FORMULATEXT(A1), A3 =SUM(Sales[Qty]), A4 FORMULATEXT(A3), A5 =S!C10, A6 FORMULATEXT(A5) (how far the cells below move), A7 =SUM(S!C4:C7), A8 FORMULATEXT(A7), A9 =ISREF(Sales) (is there still a table), A10 =INDEX(S!B:B,3) (what sheet row 3 holds after the edit, through a whole-column reference a row delete does not move).
